findings.title: The demo cites a test that does not exist as the measurement of its containment-time arming
findings.detail: The `_HOOK_PATHS` comment states that both botocore clients are already in `sys.modules` before leg 1 and that this is 'Measured by `test_the_aws_refusal_hook_is_armed_before_the_first_leg`, not assumed'. That test exists nowhere: `grep -rn armed_before_the_first_leg scripts tests .agents docs` returns exactly one hit, the comment itself. The property is TRUE today - importing the demo module and nothing else, `lambda_utils.middleware` and `lambda_utils.rate_limit` are both in `sys.modules` and `_arm_aws_refusal([])` returns 2 targets - so no claim in the transcript is currently false. What is missing is the pin. `_arm_aws_refusal` swallows a missing module with `if module is None: continue`, so if either stops arriving transitively the containment-time arming silently becomes a no-op and the only remaining hook is `_leg_coupon`'s re-arm after the handler import. `_leg_wix_giftcard` and `_leg_our_giftcard` do not re-arm, so `--leg wix-giftcard` and `--leg our-giftcard` would then run with no hook at all while `_render` still prints 'the refusing before-send hook was ARMED BEFORE leg 1'. `test_an_aws_call_during_a_leg_fails_the_run_rather_than_being_counted_afterwards` cannot substitute: it emits `before-send` from inside leg 3, after `_leg_coupon` has re-armed, so it passes whether or not containment-time arming did anything. `test_each_leg_runs_on_its_own` asserts only exit 0 and `mismatchCount == 0`. This is the same defect class the first pass raised about `_committer_of` - a named symbol presented as measured evidence and absent from the tree - and it sits on the one enforcement claim M1 was about, in the artifact the retirement gate depends on.
findings.action: Add the cited test (assert `_arm_aws_refusal([])` returns two targets before any leg runs, or that the hook is live during a `--leg wix-giftcard` run, which never re-arms), or drop the citation and state the property as unpinned.

findings.title: The coupon idempotency test's rationale contradicts this change's own measured contract transcript
findings.detail: `test_a_replayed_coupon_issue_converges_on_one_coupon`'s docstring justifies keeping `coupon_store` with "Wix's `Create Coupon` has no `idempotencyKey` and no read-by-code". Row V2b of `docs/execution/wix-contract-verification-20261002.md`, added by this same change, measures `specification.code` carrying `$eq,$ne,$hasSome,$contains,$startsWith` and concludes 'So coupons **can** be filtered by code', with the corrected framing spelled out: `coupon_store` is kept for idempotency, not for read-by-code. The test's assertions are unaffected - they rest on the conditional put, the single create on the wire and the preserved `wixCouponId`, all of which stand on the `idempotencyKey` absence alone - but the stale half of the rationale is the text the next reader will find beside the code when deciding whether `coupon_store` can be dropped.
findings.action: Narrow the docstring to the `idempotencyKey` absence, which is the fact that carries verdict (B), and drop or correct the 'no read-by-code' clause.
